raw_text: Participate in a community of readers and writers by developing group norms, discussing texts, sharing individual writing, listening as others share their writing, and offering and responding to feedback. (I/C)
competency_statement: Participate actively in a community of readers and writers by following group norms, discussing texts, sharing writing, listening to others, and giving and receiving feedback.
observable_behaviors: Follow agreed-upon group norms during reading and writing activities
Discuss texts with peers by sharing ideas and listening to others
Share individual writing pieces with the group
Listen attentively as others share their writing
Offer constructive feedback on peers' writing
Respond appropriately to feedback received on own writing
skill_clauses: Develop group norms for participation in a community of readers and writers
Discuss texts with others in the group
Share individual writing with the group
Listen to others as they share their writing
Respond to feedback received on own writing

student_actions.oral_production: Discuss texts with peers and share writing aloud
student_actions.procedural_application: Follow group norms during reading and writing activities
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Offer and respond to feedback on writing
student_actions.comprehension_response: Listen attentively to others' writing and participate in text discussions
